items.title: Demonologist: Halloween Update Is Here!
items.summary: Demonologist: Patch Notes 2.3.0 Hello Demonologists A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation map, a new safe house, a cursed item, a tutorial map, Halloween decorations, the return of limited-time Halloween outfits, over
items.content:
Demonologist: Patch Notes 2.3.0 Hello Demonologists

A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation map, a new safe house, a cursed item, a tutorial map, Halloween decorations, the return of limited-time Halloween outfits, over 110 new sequences, new achievements, gameplay improvements, performance optimizations, and much more.

The dead are calling again. Are you ready to answer?

New Content

New Map

Darkwood Junction has been added to the game.

A new location awaits those brave enough to investigate.

With over 110 new sequences to Darkwood Junction, your investigations will bring new paranormal events and unexpected encounters.

Darkness hides more than meets the eye, and not everything waiting for you in Darkwood Junction wants to be found.

Some places should remain forgotten.

New Safe House

Temple has been added as a new safe house.

A new place to prepare for your investigations awaits. Gather your courage, get ready, and take a moment before stepping back into the unknown.

New Cursed Item

Sin Coin has been added to the game.

Not every coin brings fortune. Some tempt fate, while others make you question whether the price was worth paying.

Would you risk it?

Tutorial Map

A new tutorial map has been added to help players learn the fundamentals of their investigations before facing the paranormal.

Whether you're a new investigator or simply need a refresher, this is the place to begin.

Halloween Decorations

Halloween decorations have been added to cursed locations, bringing a seasonal atmosphere to your investigations.

Even the most haunted places are celebrating Halloween. Whether you should celebrate with them is another question.

Halloween Outfits Return

Previously released Halloween outfits are back for a limited time!

Your old favorites have returned, but not for long. Make the most of this opportunity before they disappear again.

Gameplay & Systems

Communicating with the Dead Returns

You asked for it, and it's back!

The ability to communicate with your deceased friends has returned with a new twist. You can now speak with your dead friends through the Spirit Box.

Death doesn't have to be the end of the conversation.

Camera Improvements

  • Fixed an issue that caused cameras to display distorted images.

    [/*]

  • Additional improvements have been made to camera performance and reliability.

    [/*]

Field of View Fixes

  • Fixed issues related to the Field of View (FOV) that could occur when players died.

    [/*]

Performance & Optimization

Performance Improvements

  • Various optimization improvements have been implemented to improve overall performance.

    [/*]

Visual Improvements

Graphics & Lighting Fixes

  • Fixed various environmental issues.

    [/*]

  • Fixed various graphical issues.

    [/*]

  • Resolved lighting issues across the game.

    [/*]

Achievements

3 new achievements have been added to the game.

New challenges await those willing to push their investigations further.

The investigation continues...

The forests are waiting. The dead are calling again. And this Halloween, some old faces have returned.

Happy Hunting! ❤️

Clock Wizard Games

items.content:
Demonologist: Patch Notes v2.2.0

Hello Demonologists,

A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation area, a new ghost, 120 new sequences, new achievements, gameplay improvements, performance optimizations, audio updates, and much more.

New Content

New Map

Black Platform 13 has been added to the game.

A forgotten train station hidden somewhere between the world of the living and whatever lies beyond it.

Strange things have been reported on the platform. Trains arrive without warning, and some passengers may not be as alive as they appear.

Something is waiting at Platform 13.

The question is...

Super or Natural?

New Ghost

A new ghost has been added to the game.

Some spirits don't attack you directly. They prefer to deceive you.

During your investigation, not everything you see can be trusted. This ghost can make you believe you are following the right path while quietly leading you away from the truth.

Question what you see.

Not everything is as it seems.

New Events

120 new sequences have been added to the game, bringing new paranormal events and unexpected encounters to your investigations.

Gameplay & Systems

Ghost Improvements

  • Fixed an issue where the Iblis ghost could not see players hiding inside closets.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that prevented ghosts from throwing nearby objects during investigations.

    [/*]

Performance & Optimization

Performance Improvements

  • Improved performance drops that could occur when looking at screens and cameras.

    [/*]

  • Various optimization improvements have been implemented.

    [/*]

Visual Improvements

  • Fixed various graphical issues.

    [/*]

  • Various visual improvements have been made across the game.

    [/*]

Audio Improvements

  • ESG audio has been added back to the game.

    [/*]

Communication

Voice Chat Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where players revived through Tarot Cards could not reconnect to voice chat.

    [/*]

User Experience

Audio Settings

  • Fixed an issue where existing audio settings could change when launching the game.

    [/*]

Mute System

  • Fixed an issue where muted players could automatically become unmuted when the game ended.

    [/*]

Achievements

2 new achievements have been added to the game.

The investigation continues...

Watch what you see. Listen to what you hear. And remember, the truth isn't always where you think it is.

Happy Hunting! ❤️

Clock Wizard Games

items.title: Demonologist Update 2.0.0 Delivers Engine Upgrade and New Content
items.summary: Demonologist Update 2.0.0 upgrades Unreal Engine, adds Lumen lighting, introduces the Cursed Chapel map, and delivers major visual and gameplay improvements.
items.content:
Demonologist Update 2.0.0 marks a major milestone for the game, introducing a substantial engine upgrade alongside sweeping visual and atmospheric improvements. The update enhances lighting realism through the addition of Lumen and applies broad refinements across maps, safe houses, and environmental design.

Alongside technical upgrades, the patch adds new playable content, expanded customization options, updated animations, and gameplay adjustments. New sequences, achievements, and localization updates further round out one of the most comprehensive updates released to date.
